title: The Years Given Back
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who keeps checking the brown pot, and tonight Joel’s whole promise is for the ones who keep looking for green after a long gray time. Spotting the first curled shoot and shouting about it is exactly Scout’s kind of seeking.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because he is the first to spot new green after a long gray time. In Scout’s world today: Scout’s little garden pot sat brown and bare all winter, and he almost stopped checking it. One cold morning he found one curled green shoot and shouted so loud that Margo woke up. Just like the green Heavenly Father promised after the hungry time, Scout learned that Heavenly Father gives good things back.
